## About me

I am a materials scientist specialising in polysiloxane chemistry and
silicone elastomers, with experience in synthesis, formulation,
degradation, and materials characterisation.

My work connects fundamental chemistry with practical materials
development. I am particularly interested in how chemical composition
and processing influence material performance, including gas evolution,
outgassing, and degradation.

## Research interests

- Silicone formulation and functional elastomer composites
- Gas evolution, degassing, and outgassing from silicone materials
- Chemical degradation and structure–property relationships
- Analytical characterisation of polymers and degradation products
- Sustainable and multifunctional materials

## Experimental expertise

My experience includes FTIR spectroscopy, mass spectrometry,
Karl Fischer titration, rheology, and vapour-pressure measurements,
alongside silicone synthesis, formulation, and laboratory testing.
